name: Silori
tagline: Calm, fast screen capture for Linux
blurb: Silori is a lightweight screenshot tool focused on a calm capture flow, quick previewing, cropping, and simple on-image annotation.
description:
Silori is a lightweight screenshot tool focused on a calm capture flow, quick previewing, cropping, and simple on-image annotation.

Version 0.1.1 improves the preview editing workflow with better crop handling, undo and redo behavior, and stronger blur annotations.

• Capture the desktop into a preview window

• Crop screenshots before saving

• Add simple annotations such as shapes, text, highlights, and blur

• Copy captures to the clipboard or save them as PNG or JPG

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
